The '''Todirium system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Demetras sector/Legends|Demetras sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Todirium III/Legends|Todirium III]].
